output.headline: Aziz Hat-Trick Powers Southmere United Past Harbour City 3-0
output.text: Southmere United beat Harbour City 3-0 despite 50% possession each. It began with Tariq Aziz's 0.622 xG chance from 2 m, saved in the 4th minute. He made no mistake at 45+3', converting a 0.931 xG chance from 1.2 m after a Joel Martin pass, with momentum at 52. Aziz added a 0.16 xG finish in the 59th minute, assisted by Bruno Costa, then a 0.106 xG strike in the 87th after Martin's regain. Southmere United's 1.95 xG and 7 shots on target beat Harbour City's 0.62 xG and 5. PPDA was 7.9 against 7.6, and Southmere United made 62 final-third entries. Aziz, with 3 goals and 1.88 xG, was the standout.
